8394302: AArch64: Replace predicated SVE CPY with unpredicated indexed DUP for floating-point Replicate

Replace predicated SVE CPY with unpredicated indexed DUP[1] in the C2
replicateHF/F/D rules for vector lengths greater than 128 bits.

Microbenchmark testing on Neoverse V1 covers
operation.Float/DoubleMaxVector,
IndexInRangeBenchmark
IndexVectorBenchmark
from the panama-vector project [2].

The results show clear performance improvements in some microbenchmarks,
with no significant regressions observed in the remaining microbenchmarks.

Platform: Neoverse V1
Mode: thrpt
Cnt: 5
Units: ops/ms
Positive values indicate improvement

Benchmark                                           (size)   Change
IndexVectorBenchmark.floatIndexVector                1024    14.45%
IndexVectorBenchmark.floatIndexVector                2048    18.52%
IndexVectorBenchmark.floatIndexVector                4096    20.41%
operation.DoubleMaxVector.FIRST_NONZEROMaskedLanes   1024    8.86%
operation.DoubleMaxVector.FIRST_NONZEROMaskedLanes   2048    8.85%
operation.DoubleMaxVector.FIRST_NONZEROMaskedLanes   4096    9.90%
operation.DoubleMaxVector.zero                       1024    14.37%
operation.DoubleMaxVector.zero                       2048    22.76%
operation.DoubleMaxVector.zero                       4096    20.98%
operation.FloatMaxVector.FIRST_NONZEROMaskedLanes    1024    8.90%
operation.FloatMaxVector.FIRST_NONZEROMaskedLanes    2048    6.47%
operation.FloatMaxVector.FIRST_NONZEROMaskedLanes    4096    5.93%
operation.FloatMaxVector.zero                        1024    7.21%
operation.FloatMaxVector.zero                        2048    21.29%
operation.FloatMaxVector.zero                        4096    25.98%

Tier 1-3 tests passed on a 256-bit SVE-enabled Neoverse V1 machine.

The relevant cases are already covered by existing jtreg tests, including:
test/hotspot/jtreg/compiler/gallery/TestParticleLife.java
test/hotspot/jtreg/compiler/vectorapi/TestVectorBroadcastTransforms.java
test/hotspot/jtreg/compiler/c2/aarch64/TestFloat16Replicate.java

[1] https://support.arm.com/documentation/ddi0602/2026-09/SVE-Instructions/DUP--indexed---Broadcast-indexed-element-to-vector--unpredicated--?lang=en
[2] https://github.com/openjdk/panama-vector/tree/201449680526ef6632f85189739fca350e7aed55/test/micro/org/openjdk/bench/jdk/incubator/vector
